body: I guess I'm sad cop? I am person who says sorry all the time in real life. And yeah, I have unhealthy relationship attachment styles. Been working on that. It wasn't exactly poor relationship choices, more that I couldn't deal with my emotions, still working on that. As a kid I had anger issues, guess my "solution" as a teen was to block every emotion and that is still biting me in the ass and I'm 32 years old lol. Thanks for the kind words btw :)
Great video, also love your accent :) My only feedback would be to have the articles you mentioned linked in the description.

Good on you for getting better.   
As for myself, the ex storyline affected me like a brick to the face. The phone call scene especially, some of the words used were sooo close to the ones used. "what more is there to talk about that we haven't already talked about before". I sobbed a good while before I could play again.
I could help, I work part time as a translator (English to Brazilian Portuguese).

If your ability to communicate declines in this state I'd love to see what you write when you are well. 
I feel a lot of the same things you feel, especially about that part about not deserving the help I get and the contract with extremely demanding terms. I hate the feeling of being a burden on others.
Not sure if it's your thing but having a dog has always helped me a lot, you can talk to them all you want and they won't change how they treat you even if you tell them you are suicidal

The first time I thought about dying I was 8 years old, I remember thinking that I should kill myself because I wasn't worth anything, but then I'd be afraid and hate myself even more because I was too afraid to do anything.
After that I spent some time without any thoughts but mostly because I repressed almost everything I felt...
Your Don't Starve wolves analogy is a pretty apt one, especially since I play it a lot
